speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. You mentioned consuming ice cream three days before your symptoms began; did this food come from a restaurant, and were there any other people who ate from it who also became ill?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection).

The combination of recent ice cream consumption, sudden onset of fever, headache, and anorexia in a patient at 30 weeks gestation is highly suggestive of listeriosis, a serious risk during pregnancy. Given the potential severity and the need to confirm the diagnosis to guide antibiotic therapy, I will proceed with requesting a blood culture.
